mechanism_narrative: A decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the past month indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, which historically precedes negative S&P 500 forward returns as investors price in reduced corporate earnings and potential recession.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS declines.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 6.0% for three consecutive months signals a deepening labor market crisis, which has historically been followed by negative S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 20 trading days as market sentiment deteriorates.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 6.0% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 110 and housing starts (HOUST) below 1000 signals a severe contraction in both manufacturing and residential construction, which has historically led to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in a deepening recession.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both INDPRO < 110 and HOUST < 1000.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary easing cycle (FEDFUNDS below 3.0% and declining for two consecutive months), the S&P 500 typically experiences positive forward returns over a 60-day horizon as the market anticipates accommodative policy supporting equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances during monetary easing cycles (FEDFUNDS < 3.0% and declining).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over the past month indicates weakening consumer demand, which has historically been followed by negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as the market reacts to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where RSAFS declines.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPI (CPIAUCSL) falls below 1.0%, it signals deflationary pressures that have historically led to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days as investors anticipate central bank inaction and economic stagnation.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY < 1.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 6.0% and decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 110 signals a severe economic contraction, which has historically led to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days as the market prices in a deepening recession and reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 6.0% and INDPRO < 110.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1000, it signals a collapse in the residential construction sector, which has historically been followed by negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days as the market anticipates a broader economic downturn.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST < 1000.
